cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Handle the Impossible Part
cards.instruction: Make someone accept responsibility for the one part of the plan that cannot reasonably be done.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Put yesterday's missing hour in this jar before lunch.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then loosen the lid. Don't make the opening smaller than necessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm labelling. We mustn't confuse it with tomorrow.

mechanism: A claims control of a shared plan while reserving an easy descriptive job and forcing B to own impossible time storage.
confusable: Unlike merely issuing a surreal request, A must defend the unequal responsibility when B tries to return the task.
comparison: A time exhibit with labeling differs from a film audience waiting for a moon blackout.
seedUse: Use the canonical hour-and-jar seed as context only; its protected single status is unchanged, and this is a separate exact-pair assessment.
